title: chronexa
tagline: A modern date and time toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript, with explicit time zones.
highlights: Immutable DateTime that never rolls Feb 30 over into March
Explicit time zones, DST gaps and overlaps with a documented disambiguation policy
Durations, half-open intervals, business-day calendars and recurrence rules
Zero dependencies, ESM + CJS, built on Intl, about 13.5 kB min+gzip
